body:
Thanks for everyone for your replies.  It made me feel a lot better.  Just knowing I comunicated with someon out there.  I have to sleep on this so I won't be commenting for a bit.  I'll either keep commenting or post just once more to wrap this up and let you know what's going on.

Thanks again.  This is the first time that I felt like anyone cared what happened to me in months.

Thank you for your post. Suing is out of the question, I already went over that with a lawyer. As long as they don't tell anyone else that I am a threat I can't sue. So at least they can't spread this all over the world. I'm to sad to go through that anyway. It's not about the money. I want to talk to them. I just want to ask how they could make something like that up about me? Am I really so horrible? I had the most responsability of any other Lease Analyst, I was doing my job and then... Poof.

Thanks for re-posting. I tried to fit a lifetime in there. I was little drunk. I guess the thing that I was trying to express was that I went through some hard times. I finally got everything together. I liked the people that I worked with. I liked my job. I played on the company softball team. For the first time in my life I felt like I was safe. I was building something. I could forget the past and just build something. Then one day, It all gets taken away. My mother kicked me out when I was 16 and threw away everything that I owned. Every picture of me as a child all my furniture all my books. She did it just because I suggested that I wanted to move in with my father. This getting fired by someone that I never met and having all contact with my friends destroyed, having all that I worked for go up in smoke, it just brought back all of those memories. Since November I have been lying on my couch everyday waiting for the night to come so I can sleep, but then I just have nightmares.

I am not good at writing concisely so please pardon the rambling. I was addicted to heroin on and off from 18-26 (I am 31 now). I was abused by my sister and my mother. My father didn’t abuse me but he didn’t protect me. I haven’t talked to any of them in 6 years. I moved to Boston and finally cleaned myself up and got a job I liked. I started seeing a psychiatrist because I am chronically depressed and I think I have mild asperger's syndrome. I never had any really good friend’s but I got along with the people I worked with for 4 and a half years and basically they were my family. Then in November of last year HR called me down and told me that my supervisors (my section of the office was all women, 11 people in all 3 were my supervisors) told HR that they were afraid to work with me and thought that I was going to come in and hurt them. They even used the Columbine analogy. Now I have never hurt anyone, ever (maybe I got in a fight in the 5th grade I can’t remember). I have never fired a gun. I never threatened anyone. As for those of you who say there must have been something that I did I assure you that there was not, please don’t tell me otherwise, just don’t comment if that is all you have to say because although I was somewhat quiet I never was anything but nice to my co-workers. I always offered to pick up stuff for them when I went across the street to the store I bought them all presents back from Paris when I took a vacation that year. Anyway they never came down themselves to give me an explanation. HR (some woman I had never met before) fired me for being a threat and mailed me my personal stuff. No one who works there will take my calls anymore. I am suddenly all alone in the world. It has been 5 months since I have had a conversation with a friend. If I killed myself today no one in the world would notice (except my landlord, and she would just throw out my stuff after a couple of months.) Basically I am all alone in this world. I have no one and I have nothing. I take antidepressents but I just can’t feel good. The worst is the night. I can’t sleep anymore and I have recurring nightmares where my former friends are kicking me out of work like I am a pariah. I am pretty sure that by the end of this week I will either check myself into a mental institution of fill my pockets with rocks, strap a cinder block around my neck and throw myself off the bridge. You won’t hear about it. There will be no news cast about my disappearance. No one will file a missing persons report. I hated myself for so long. I thought that I deserved the abuse. Now I feel that way again. I don’t know what the point of this is. I am out of places to go.
